name: Coarse-to-Fine Octree Update Strategy
definition: A strategy to accelerate octree updating and reduce noise impact by initially using down-sampled projections, then fixing the octree structure to optimize only density grids with original projections.
summary: This strategy accelerates sparse voxel octree updates by decoupling topology changes from density optimization, using low-resolution projections first to mitigate noise before refining densities with high-resolution data.
